Bookkeeping & admin tools for Electricians

Tools that help electricians with bookkeeping & admin. Categorising expenses, capturing receipts and keeping the accounts current.

Where Bookkeeping & admin goes wrong for Electricians

Electrical businesses carry high-value stock and certification costs that have to be tracked per job. Mixing materials bought for one job into another is what makes job margins impossible to read.

What Electricians jobs really involve

Electrical work carries certification and documentation duties that most other trades do not, so paperwork is genuinely part of the job rather than an optional extra. Records of what was installed and tested matter long after the invoice is paid.

Frequently asked questions

Which bookkeeping & admin tools work best for electricians?

The three that fit best here are QuickBooks (Businesses that need proper books and an accountant who already knows the software), Xero (Businesses wanting cloud accounting with trade-specific add-ons), Dext (Businesses drowning in paper receipts for materials). Start with the one whose description matches your crew size, not the one with the longest feature list.

How much does bookkeeping & admin software cost for electricians?

Across the 3 tools on this page, 0 have a free tier and the rest are paid, most of them billed per user per month. Prices change often, so treat the figures here as indicative and confirm on the vendor site.

Why does bookkeeping & admin cause problems for electricians specifically?

Electrical businesses carry high-value stock and certification costs that have to be tracked per job. Mixing materials bought for one job into another is what makes job margins impossible to read.

Do I need software that stores electrical certificates?

Any system that lets you attach test results and certificates to a job and find them again later is enough. Dedicated certification apps only start to matter when you are issuing a large number of certificates every month.
